title: SSRF attempt blocked
description: Someone configured or triggered a webhook towards a private, loopback or cloud metadata address. NEXORA blocked it; the attempt itself is suspicious.

mitre.name: Unsecured Credentials: Cloud Instance Metadata API

false_positives: A developer pointing a webhook at a local test server (only possible outside production).
tuning: Any hit on 169.254.169.254 or metadata hostnames should be investigated.
